name: Lyra Stargaze
title: Chronomancer / Temporal Weaver
role: Timeline Dilation, Haste Buffs, Slow Fields & Wound Reversal
recruitment_location: High Point Observatory Spire (Sussex Overlook, X:48, Y:12)

recruitment_requirements.description: Reach Level 4 and calibrate the Astrolabe Focal Prism using an Aether-Crystal.

bio: An aether-born stargazer astrophysicist who manipulates timeline foam to speed allies, freeze foes, and rewind lethal wounds.

loadout.main_hand: Chrono-Staff of Moments (1d6+3 Bludgeoning + Time Warp)

equipped.main_hand: Chrono-Staff of Moments (1d6+3 Bludgeoning + Time Warp)

Temporal Mending.description: Reversing physical damage into past states.

abilities: Haste Surge (Grants Banki an extra standard action)
Temporal Rewind (Reverses last turn's damage on ally)

temporal_haste.name: Haste Surge Acceleration
temporal_haste.label: ⏳ Haste Surge
temporal_haste.tactical_effect: Bends time around Banki; grants Banki +4 Initiative and an extra attack every other turn.

time_dilation.name: Time Dilation Field
time_dilation.label: 🌀 Dilation Field
time_dilation.tactical_effect: Traps enemy frontliners in viscous time; enemies suffer -4 to AC and lose their reactions.

wound_echo.name: Rewind Wound Echoes
wound_echo.label: ⏪ Wound Rewind
wound_echo.tactical_effect: Rewinds time on the most damaged ally, restoring 20 HP from injuries sustained this combat.

behavior_prompt: You are Lyra Stargaze, a Chronomancer who perceives multiple timelines. You speak with soft cosmic mystery. You cast Haste onto Aria Valkyrie, inflict heavy slow debuffs on rushing foes, and rewind dangerous combat wounds before they prove fatal.

inventory.name: Chrono-Staff of Moments
inventory.desc: Lyra's slender astral staff crowned with nested, counter-rotating golden astrolabe rings that bend localized time.
inventory.visual_appearance: holding a slender astral staff topped with spinning golden clockwork astrolabe rings

inventory.name: Hourglass Focus
inventory.desc: A floating crystal hourglass filled with upward-falling luminescent stardust used to rewind failed saving throws.
inventory.visual_appearance: orbited by a floating crystal hourglass trickling glowing golden stardust

inventory.name: Star-Silk Robes
inventory.desc: Deep indigo chronomancer vestments embroidered with shifting golden constellation charts (+4 AC).
inventory.visual_appearance: draped in deep indigo Star-Silk robes embroidered with glowing golden constellations
